# Auth (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`media`](../../flows/media/FLOW.md), [`owner-setup`](../../flows/owner-setup/FLOW.md), [`password`](../../flows/password/FLOW.md), [`sign-in`](../../flows/sign-in/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Keeps the admin session: sign-in with optional 2FA, in-memory access token, silent refresh, password reset and first-owner setup. Used by every protected screen.

## Techniques

Redux auth slice; Bearer header and 401 refresh-and-retry in one axios interceptor; single-flight and cross-tab refresh. Calls flagged `shouldRefreshExpiringToken` (uploads) refresh first when the token expires within 60 s or its expiry is unreadable.

## Technologies

axios, Redux Toolkit, React Query, react-hook-form.

## Entry points

`index.ts` (hooks, form shapes), `SessionProvider`, `ProtectedRoute`, `installAuthInterceptor`.

## Where to change what

Token header or refresh rules: `Auth.interceptor.ts` only. A new call that must not expire mid-flight sets `shouldRefreshExpiringToken: true`.
